Toddler meals

Potato and zucchini bake

Rakott burgonya

8 months+ Adjusted 50 min 4 portions

Serve warm. The potato should mash easily with a fork.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 400 g Potatoes (Peeled and sliced thin)
  • 1 medium Zucchini (Sliced thin)
  • 2 medium Tomatoes (Sliced)
  • 200 ml Full-fat milk (Pasteurized)
  • 30 g Mild cheese (Pasteurized, grated)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Layer the potato, zucchini, and tomato in a small dish.
  3. Pour the milk over the vegetables.
  4. Scatter the cheese on top.
  5. Bake until the potato is soft and the milk has thickened, about 40 minutes.
  6. Rest for a few minutes and serve in soft spoonfuls.

Adjusted

Cream and salt are the usual extras this tray does not need. Milk and a little cheese are enough to bring it together.

Bake potato, zucchini, and tomato in milk with a little cheese. Add no salt and no cream.
